desc: The Alpha Foxtrot AF1911 Atilla in 9mm Luger delivers a compensated 3.5" bull-ramped barrel, optic-ready slide, and a compact double-stack 15+1 configuration in a modernized 1911-style platform. This pistol maintains controlled handling through its aluminum frame, Black DLC finish, and balanced stainless-steel slide. Its ergonomic beavertail frame and consistent performance position it as a capable compact 9mm 1911 suited for defensive and performance-focused roles.
